bounds.domain: One caller and one tile, one authorization bit and one HTTP cache entry. Any sequence of requests, authorization and revocation is allowed.
bounds.atomicity: Each request completes within one authorization state. Existing server admission owns mid-request revocation and is outside this HTTP cache projection.
bounds.progress: No fairness or provider-availability claim. An unauthorized request may be refused indefinitely.

limitations: Assumes clients and intermediaries follow HTTP no-store. Does not prove browser or Cloudflare implementations.
Current-map rendering memory, Google session tokens, device/native transport and organization quota enforcement are outside this projection.
The existing provider/route tests check no-store request and response metadata and preserved bytes; their Google boundary is a controlled fetch, not a live provider.
